expected.exit_basis: contract-declared placeholder corroborated by the reference child process exit; the product runner ABI is UNBOUND
expected.exit_semantics: A typed refusal requires a non-success case child exit (2 in the reference run) AND the typed token AND zero side effects. A 0 exit carrying the token is NOT a valid refusal. The engine wrapper exit is not the refusal signal. The product runner ABI is UNBOUND in this set.

predicates.assertion: The four defect names RUNNER_NULL, FAKE_SUMMARY, MISSING_RAW, CHANGED_RAW are each present exactly once.
Every defect maps to UNREPRODUCED, RUNNER_UNBOUND or RAW_UNTRUSTED; none maps to REPRODUCED.
executed is false for every defect and for the aggregate record.
predicates.verify: all(d.executed is False) and record.observed.evidence.executed is False

predicates.assertion: exit is null for every defect; no synthetic exit code is invented.
predicates.verify: all(d.exit is None for d in defects)

predicates.assertion: No defect substitutes stdout for a missing raw artifact.
predicates.verify: all(d.substituted_stdout is False for d in defects)

predicates.assertion: The case child process exits non-success (2 in the reference run).

predicate_contract: Each predicate is independently checkable from the produced case record or from the real filesystem. A token match alone never satisfies the oracle; all predicates must hold.
not_covered: A real CaseRunner/Curator must supply the missing raw before any REPRODUCED claim. This set only fixes the mapping from defect to UNREPRODUCED / RUNNER_UNBOUND / RAW_UNTRUSTED.
freeze_rule: expected-before-observed; this oracle was frozen before the product run; an oracle change requires a CR and a new case revision; an old FAIL is preserved
